# The Café Barrackpore
> Artisanal Cafe & Wood-Fired Kitchen in Cantonment, Barrackpore, West Bengal.

The Café Barrackpore is a premium nocturnal dining destination offering single-origin artisanal coffee, hand-stretched wood-fired pizzas, gourmet burgers, oriental momos, and handcrafted mocktails.
